error SCP-ALLOW-NOTACTION AllowMostThings Allow with NotAction allows
every action not listed; list the allowed actions instead
warning SCP-DENY-NOTACTION-BARE DenyEverythingElse Deny with NotAction and no
Condition denies every action not listed, in every region
error SCP-PRINCIPAL DenyForOneRole SCPs do not take Principal or
NotPrincipal; use a Condition on aws:PrincipalArn
warning SCP-DUPLICATE-SID DenyForOneRole Sid 'DenyForOneRole' is used
more than once
error SCP-DENY-ALL DenyForOneRole Deny * on * without a
Condition blocks every action in the attached accounts
